column_info.desc: Proposing a new candidate threshold position physically along an ordered numeric feature sequence to test for better group separation.
Isolating and identifying specific data instances that violate the active classification decision rule (e.g., listing Gummy Bears, Crispbread, Oats, Avocado).
Evaluating and comparing the Misclassification Rate (MCR) of two distinct split boundaries to justify why one threshold yields a superior model performance (e.g., reducing error counts from 4 to 2).
Recognizing constraints in continuous feature splitting when multiple adjacent data points share identical feature values (e.g., noting that Apple and Raspberry Jam share the same fat values).

Finding the mathematical midpoint or boundary interval between sorted instances of a new independent variable to minimize overall classification error (e.g., identifying the threshold between 160 kcal and 223 kcal).
